# Ultha (ultha.co)

> Ultha Moktan helps founder-led B2B AI startups find their next power users. She talks to a startup's best customers, finds what they have in common, and shows the team who to go after next. AI research gives everyone the same answers; real calls don't.

About: Launched products and ran marketing for 40+ brands as co-founder of a marketing agency. Customer research she ran led to +34% and +17% feature adoption. Based in Santa Barbara, CA. Contact: ultha@ultha.co.

## Plan and prices
- Find your next power users, $11,500 (takes 30 to 45 days): 10-15 interviews with your power users; insights on who they are, why they chose you and why they stick; a messaging recommendation to attract more power users; and an adoption plan to turn average users into power users. The founder makes warm intros; Ultha handles scheduling, interviews and analysis. https://ultha.co/pricing
- Add-ons (price on request): extra interviews, a monthly working session, testimonial videos (https://ultha.co/testimonial-videos).
- Something custom: scoped on request. https://ultha.co/pricing#custom
- Book a 30-minute call: https://calendly.com/ultha-ultha/30min

## Who it's for
Founder-led B2B software startups, mostly AI, with real customers and nobody owning customer research yet. Common questions: "a few customers use us every day and we don't know why", "who should we go after next", "how do we get average users to use us like our best ones".

## Methods
Customer interviews, power user research, jobs-to-be-done (switch) questions, voice-of-customer research, building an ideal customer profile (ICP) from best customers. Calls are confidential; quotes are anonymized unless a customer agrees.
